environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. ALB access logs enabled to S3 but no active rule processing. The application process runs as ec2-user with the SQLite database file at /var/data/users.db. Environment variable VALID_API_KEYS contains SHA-256 hashes of issued keys. No additional middleware or proxy filtering is applied.
